# HoneyHaus merchant handoff

## Preview and Shopify theme

The hosted design concept has a local demonstration bag and illustrative checkout. The theme ZIP is an independent native Shopify implementation with editable homepage sections, product templates and Shopify checkout. Catalogue, customers and transactions come from the Shopify store in which the theme is installed. The ZIP contains the theme source.

1. In Shopify admin, open Online Store → Themes → Import theme → Upload zip file. Upload HoneyHaus-Theme.zip to the theme library, then choose Preview. Keep the current live theme published throughout review.
2. Under Products, create or confirm the three Closet styles and one wig as draft records. Upload accurate, approved product images per colour. Create real variants, GBP prices, SKU, weight, inventory and fulfilment settings. Assign variant images explicitly. Confirm the final spelling of Zipper. Products with incomplete data should stay in draft.
3. Create HoneyHaus Closet and HoneyHaus Hair collections. Group the bodysuit under Everyday Essentials and both shapers under Shapewear. Add a second wig to Hair when it is ready; the collection page draws its cards from the collection.
4. Create About and Contact pages. Assign the contact template to Contact. Populate page content, add the care and legal menu, and enter genuine policy texts under store settings. Under theme settings choose the two collections, the two information pages and optional replacement logo. In the footer select the correct menu.
5. In the homepage editor replace editorial photographs, assign the circular navigation destinations, select the Closet collection, and link the Hair feature and individual garment details. Set customer care link destinations. Supply the approved wig portrait and confirm it represents the item being sold. The theme’s campaign uses the supplied monogram and wordmark over an editorial fabric-and-model composition. Its Hair story shows a concept portrait. Add an approved product photo before publication.
6. Add product metafield definitions under the custom namespace: size_guide, fit, care and wig_details, using rich text. Add product-specific charts to the gallery plus readable measurements to the size guide. The Zipper chart has supplier sizing and a US column; Plunge uses UK sizes in inches; the long-sleeve piece requires its own fit guide. Confirm Plunge fibre information against its label.
7. Configure the merchant inbox, payment gateway, UK markets/currency, shipping regions/rates and inventory. Use the checkout and accounts editor for supported branding. Enable customer accounts and the intended guest checkout settings. Confirm actual cookie technology and consent configuration. Add any real returns email in the Contact section.
8. Enable Shopify test mode or use a development store. Test a mixed cart, colour changes, a sold-out variant, a missing size choice, quantity changes, reload, guest and account checkout, shipping and taxes, order status, receipt, tracking and delivery of a contact enquiry. Check desktop/mobile keyboard navigation and all footer links. Launch after the owner approves product data, policies, payments and test results.

## Editing the current design

Open the Campaign opening section to change the desktop/mobile background and ten-line introduction. The supplied cream stacked HoneyHaus Closet logo appears over the campaign; the header reveals its logo on scroll. The brown stacked version appears in the light footer and centre of the world collage. Gilda Display headings and 18px Jost body type are bundled locally. The espresso and blush palette uses #3a2316 and #ebd7c6.

In the theme editor, each category circle links to a merchant-selected collection or product. Select the Closet collection and real product/variants to enable native quick add, size/colour choice and sold-out states. The heart saves the product reference in the visitor’s browser. Configure destinations in both collection panels, and choose one featured product in Recreate the Look.

Edit the two marquees independently. The material feature has four editable image frames with a motion toggle, plus a heading, copy and CTA. The floating brand story takes three editorial photos. The editorial notes slider accepts photo, title and copy for each note. Keep this copy attributed to the brand; include testimonial claims only with real customer permission and evidence. Four styling accordion blocks each select a matching photograph. Each silhouette item has an icon, photograph and destination. The world collage accepts eight editorial photos. The footer displays the store’s configured legal and support links.

## Owner decisions for launch

Please provide the wig’s final title, original approved photos and specifications; actual GBP prices, variants and inventory; verified size charts; shipping destinations, rates, dispatch terms and any free-delivery threshold; returns email, postal address and packaging/seal details; final garment names; trading details, contact inbox, payment provider and approved policies. Confirm rights to use all final commercial photographs.

## Refund and chargeback handling

Give shoppers an accessible “Request a return” contact route, with order reference and items. Agree the refund method, times, postage and where to send returns. For UK distance purchases consider the usual 14-day cancellation notice period and further 14 days to send goods back, plus standard outbound delivery where applicable. An opened-seal hygiene exception applies only if the product and seal qualify. Preserve rights for faulty or misdescribed goods. Confirm wording against current guidance and the merchant’s situation. https://www.gov.uk/accepting-returns-and-giving-refunds

For Shopify Payments a chargeback opened by a cardholder’s bank can debit the disputed amount and a fee. Check the dispute in admin, note the response deadline and submit relevant listing, checkout, tracking and customer correspondence when eligible. The issuer determines the outcome. Follow the gateway procedure before issuing any separate refund while a case is open. https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/chargebacks

## Keeping the domain

An in-store theme rebrand can keep honeyhaus.co.uk and its current registrar. Before any future replatforming, check who manages the domain and preserve email DNS records. If transferring a Shopify-managed .co.uk to another registrar, ask the new registrar for its IPS tag and contact Shopify Support. Maintain HTTPS and redirects. https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/domains/managing-domain-ownership/transferring-shopify-domains

## Verification

Local checks validated the ZIP hierarchy, section settings JSON, template references, section block order, local assets and JavaScript syntax. Shopify admin installation, gateway testing, order email delivery and private merchant configuration require access to the merchant's Shopify store.
